notes: Agent must read the SQLite header fields, classify the truncation mode (intact / page_aligned / mid_page), and implement a salvage strategy (zero-pad to the header-declared size, open read-only, probe rowids individually tolerating malformed-image errors) that recovers rows on complete pages AND rows on a partial page whose cells lie within the surviving bytes. Nonzero reasoning_depth (header decoding + three-way mode classification + partial-page subtlety), debugging_ambiguity (must empirically discover which rows of the partial page survive; wrong strategy silently loses rows), quantitative_correctness (exact ints/floats in the report), hidden_case_generalization (4 hidden DBs covering all three modes and different sizes).
